Arshdeep Singh Reportedly Moving to Mumbai Indians in IPL 2027

Cricketer Arshdeep Singh is reportedly set to play for the Mumbai Indians team in the 2027 Indian Premier League (IPL) season. His father has confirmed this move. Following the announcement of his impending transfer, Arshdeep Singh conveyed a message stating, "We will shake the world."
